package lessonrelation

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

const (
	testSourceLessonID = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
	testTargetLessonID = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
	testRelationID     = "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
)

type lessonRepositoryStub struct {
	lessons map[string]domain.Lesson
}

func (r lessonRepositoryStub) Create(context.Context, domain.Lesson) error { return nil }
func (r lessonRepositoryStub) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	lesson, ok := r.lessons[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &lesson, nil
}
func (r lessonRepositoryStub) GetWithFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (r lessonRepositoryStub) Update(context.Context, domain.Lesson) error { return nil }
func (r lessonRepositoryStub) Delete(context.Context, string) error        { return nil }
func (r lessonRepositoryStub) ListByCourse(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (r lessonRepositoryStub) ListByCourseFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set, filters.LessonFilters, *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	return nil, 0, nil
}
func (r lessonRepositoryStub) ListBySection(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

type relationRepositoryStub struct {
	replacedSource string
	replaced       []domain.LessonRelation
	listed         []domain.LessonRelation
	deleted        string
}

func (r *relationRepositoryStub) ReplaceBySourceLesson(_ context.Context, sourceLessonID string, relations []domain.LessonRelation) error {
	r.replacedSource = sourceLessonID
	r.replaced = relations
	return nil
}
func (r *relationRepositoryStub) ListBySourceLesson(context.Context, string) ([]domain.LessonRelation, error) {
	return r.listed, nil
}
func (r *relationRepositoryStub) Delete(_ context.Context, relationID string) error {
	r.deleted = relationID
	return nil
}

func TestReplaceLessonRelationsNormalizesAndPersists(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := lessonRepositoryStub{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{
		testSourceLessonID: {ID: testSourceLessonID},
		testTargetLessonID: {ID: testTargetLessonID},
	}}
	relations := &relationRepositoryStub{}
	primary := "javascript"
	uc := ReplaceLessonRelations{Lessons: lessons, Relations: relations}

	err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), testSourceLessonID, []domain.LessonRelation{{
		ID:             testRelationID,
		SourceKey:      "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript",
		TargetLessonID: testTargetLessonID,
		Relation:       domain.LessonRelationImplementation,
		PrimaryStack:   &primary,
		Stacks:         []string{"javascript"},
		Concepts:       []string{"sequence"},
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replace relations: %v", err)
	}
	if relations.replacedSource != testSourceLessonID || len(relations.replaced) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected replacement: source=%q relations=%#v", relations.replacedSource, relations.replaced)
	}
	if relations.replaced[0].SourceLessonID != testSourceLessonID {
		t.Fatalf("source lesson was not normalized: %#v", relations.replaced[0])
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonRelationsAcceptsEmptySetForReconciliation(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := lessonRepositoryStub{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{testSourceLessonID: {ID: testSourceLessonID}}}
	relations := &relationRepositoryStub{}

	err := (ReplaceLessonRelations{Lessons: lessons, Relations: relations}).Handle(context.Background(), testSourceLessonID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replace with empty set: %v", err)
	}
	if relations.replaced == nil || len(relations.replaced) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected a non-nil empty replacement, got %#v", relations.replaced)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonRelationsSupportsKnowledgeTreeKinds(t *testing.T) {
	for kind := range supportedRelations {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			items, err := normalizeRelations(testSourceLessonID, []domain.LessonRelation{{
				ID:             testRelationID,
				SourceKey:      "lesson-relation.kind." + kind,
				TargetLessonID: testTargetLessonID,
				Relation:       kind,
				Concepts:       []string{"sequence"},
			}})
			if err != nil || len(items) != 1 || items[0].Relation != kind {
				t.Fatalf("kind %q was not accepted: items=%#v err=%v", kind, items, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonRelationsRejectsInvalidEdges(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := lessonRepositoryStub{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{
		testSourceLessonID: {ID: testSourceLessonID},
		testTargetLessonID: {ID: testTargetLessonID},
	}}
	base := domain.LessonRelation{
		ID:             testRelationID,
		SourceKey:      "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript",
		TargetLessonID: testTargetLessonID,
		Relation:       domain.LessonRelationImplementation,
		Stacks:         []string{"javascript"},
		Concepts:       []string{"sequence"},
	}

	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		relations []domain.LessonRelation
	}{
		{name: "self relation", relations: []domain.LessonRelation{{ID: testRelationID, SourceKey: base.SourceKey, TargetLessonID: testSourceLessonID, Relation: base.Relation, Concepts: base.Concepts}}},
		{name: "unsupported kind", relations: []domain.LessonRelation{{ID: testRelationID, SourceKey: base.SourceKey, TargetLessonID: base.TargetLessonID, Relation: "planned", Concepts: base.Concepts}}},
		{name: "missing concepts", relations: []domain.LessonRelation{{ID: testRelationID, SourceKey: base.SourceKey, TargetLessonID: base.TargetLessonID, Relation: base.Relation}}},
		{name: "duplicate identity", relations: []domain.LessonRelation{base, {ID: "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004", SourceKey: "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript.duplicate", TargetLessonID: base.TargetLessonID, Relation: base.Relation, Concepts: base.Concepts}}},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			err := (ReplaceLessonRelations{Lessons: lessons, Relations: &relationRepositoryStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), testSourceLessonID, tt.relations)
			if err == nil || (!errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) && !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict)) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation or conflict error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonRelationsRejectsDanglingTarget(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := lessonRepositoryStub{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{testSourceLessonID: {ID: testSourceLessonID}}}
	err := (ReplaceLessonRelations{Lessons: lessons, Relations: &relationRepositoryStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), testSourceLessonID, []domain.LessonRelation{{
		ID:             testRelationID,
		SourceKey:      "lesson-relation.sequence.javascript",
		TargetLessonID: testTargetLessonID,
		Relation:       domain.LessonRelationReference,
		Concepts:       []string{"sequence"},
	}})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("expected dangling target to fail with not found, got %v", err)
	}
}
